| 0x01 | `replacement_signal` | Internally generated client replacement signal |

#### `np_source_tx`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `host_path_signal` | Signal received from Host Path |
| 0x01 | `replacement_signal` | Internally generated client replacement signal |

#### `acs_np_in_use_lane`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `dp_or_unused` | Host lane is part of a DP Application Data Path or is unused |
| 0x01 | `np_in_use` | Host lane is part of a Host Path feeding the Network Path identified by NPID |

#### `ext_app_descriptor`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `dp_application` | Application Descriptor describes a supported DP Application |
| 0x01 | `np_application` | Application Descriptor partly describes a supported NP Application |
